Name: Em's Scavenger Pets (raccoon and opossum)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Give two scavengers a home on your farm
Adopt raccoons and opossums from Marnie
They need a regular pet bowl and eventually bring you little treasures
Available for Content Patcher

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55632/55632-1794839292-1154776189.png[/img]

Raccoons have four coat colours to choose from
They bring broken glasses, and broken cd's at first
Once acquainted, they will leave you apricots and apples

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55632/55632-1794839310-1025695011.png[/img]

Possums have two options to choose from, carrying their young or just by themselves
They bring coal, and glass shards when feeling at home
Eventually finding you plums and blackberries

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Scavenger Pets"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!
